senses.gloss: adv. (b. h.; downward, (used as a noun) below. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 23">B’shall. 23</cite> <he>מחמת אש של מעלה … של מ׳</he> through the fire from above were his wheels below ignited; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 235:4">Yalk. Ex. 235</cite> <he>שלמעלן … שלמַטָּן</he>, v. infra).

<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:1">Ḥag. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Chagigah 11b:24">11ᵇ</cite>) <he>מה למעלה ומה למ׳</he> what is above (in heaven) and what is below (in the nether world, Rashi: above the Ḥayoth, below the Ḥayoth, v. <cite ref="H00672"><he>חַיָּה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:5">Tosef. Ber. V, 5</cite> <he>שלישי לו למ׳ הימנו</he> he who is the third in rank reclines below him (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Triclinium); a. fr.—Euphem. for <cite ref="M02130"><he>מעלה</he></cite> in order to avoid a blasphemous expression: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 79b:8">B. Kam. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>כביכול עשה עין של מ׳ … ואוזן של מ׳ וכ׳</he> he treated, if one may say so, the divine eye as if did not see, and the divine ear as if did not hear.—Frequ. <cite ref="M01033"><he>מַטָּן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 7:2:5">Y. Yoma VII, 44ᵇ</cite> <he>כשירות של מעלן … של מ׳</he> as the service in heaven, so is that on earth; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21">Lev. R. s. 21</cite>, end (not <he>שורות</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:2">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ב״ד שלמ׳</he> the court on earth; a. fr.
